# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

[ EXPLORE THE PIPELINE ][76]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

#### Stallion is a people’s company, completely dedicated to its customers, partners and communities
#### around the facilities in West Africa. It has worked in the Sub Saharan region for the past 50
#### years by developing businesses around agriculture, food, commodities, automobiles, logistics,
#### plastics & packaging, business solution services to name a few. It has invested significantly
#### towards building large-scale local industries in Africa, deploying most recent technologies,
#### generating employment and strongly endorsing the concept of domestic production.

 

## Stallion Empowerment Initiative

 

#### **Stallion Empowerment Initiative is a philanthropic endeavour of Stallion Group founded by
#### Sarina Vaswani in 2019**. The initiative was introduced in Nigeria with the intentions to have
#### an overall socio-economic impact across West Africa in the future.

 

#### Our CSR initiatives tackle social issues at both local and national level in order to develop
#### scalable, impactful and sustainable social programmes that leave a vision for future
#### generations. SEI is committed to improving the socio-economic conditions of the communities in
#### West Africa that it does business with. Our present key focus is to support and scale
#### education, healthcare & scaling youth empowerment across Nigeria.


### Education

Stallion Empowerment Initiative’s first pillars of development has been on education. Sub-Saharan
Africa as a region has a rough estimate of 64% illiteracy. This is the highest in the world. It is
crucial for Nigeria to set a benchmark as one of the leading economies in Africa to improve the
access and opportunities available for young individuals.

[SEI_education]
[SEI_healthcare]

### Healthcare

SEI supports a clinic and a 50-bed hospital with special wards for female and pediatric health care
services in the Aladja region in Warri, Delta State. The community around the hospital is largely
rural and socio economically backward. On an average it serves 50 out patients in a day.

### Youth Empowerment

SEI outreach in 391 villages and approximately 40,000 rice farmers to support better yield and
sustained livelihood in Nigeria. It works through PPP with government’s agriculture objectives to
train small scale farmers. The impact is in 12 rice producing states across Nigeria with the best
techniques in field planting, seed management, harvesting, drying and threshing.

#### Stallion is a people’s company, completely dedicated to its customers, partners and communities
#### around the facilities in West Africa. It has worked in the Sub Saharan region for the past 50
#### years by developing businesses around agriculture, food, commodities, automobiles, logistics,
#### plastics & packaging, business solution services to name a few. It has invested significantly
#### towards building large-scale local industries in Africa, deploying most recent technologies,
#### generating employment and strongly endorsing the concept of domestic production.

 

## Stallion Empowerment Initiative

 

#### **Stallion Empowerment Initiative is a philanthropic endeavour of Stallion Group founded by
#### Sarina Vaswani in 2019**. The initiative was introduced in Nigeria with the intentions to have
#### an overall socio-economic impact across West Africa in the future.

 

#### Our CSR initiatives tackle social issues at both local and national level in order to develop
#### scalable, impactful and sustainable social programmes that leave a vision for future
#### generations. SEI is committed to improving the socio-economic conditions of the communities in
#### West Africa that it does business with. Our present key focus is to support and scale
#### education, healthcare & scaling youth empowerment across Nigeria.


### Education

Stallion Empowerment Initiative’s first pillars of development has been on education. Sub-Saharan
Africa as a region has a rough estimate of 64% illiteracy. This is the highest in the world. It is
crucial for Nigeria to set a benchmark as one of the leading economies in Africa to improve the
access and opportunities available for young individuals.

[SEI_education]
[SEI_healthcare]

### Healthcare

SEI supports a clinic and a 50-bed hospital with special wards for female and pediatric health care
services in the Aladja region in Warri, Delta State. The community around the hospital is largely
rural and socio economically backward. On an average it serves 50 out patients in a day.

### Youth Empowerment

SEI outreach in 391 villages and approximately 40,000 rice farmers to support better yield and
sustained livelihood in Nigeria. It works through PPP with government’s agriculture objectives to
train small scale farmers. The impact is in 12 rice producing states across Nigeria with the best
techniques in field planting, seed management, harvesting, drying and threshing.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

### Vision & Mission
### 
### Mission et Vision

Our vision is to secure access to quality drugs. Our mission, with a pharmaceutical market that
represents more than $20 billion, bringing people quality products at affordable prices remains a
key challenge in Africa. CFAO Healthcare continues to improve healthcare on the continent by
producing and distributing pharmaceutical and medical products along with related services.

[ View more ][134]

### Carbon neutrality

Like the CFAO group as a whole, CFAO Healthcare is committed to contributing to decarbonization
efforts by aligning itself with the trajectory of the Paris agreements: reducing our greenhouse gas
emissions by 50% by 2030 compared with 2019 and achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.

[ View more ][135]

## Health54

#### CFAO group investment vehicle dedicated to health

Talent is everywhere across the 54 countries, but entrepreneurship is restraint by a lack of capital
and resources to grow and scale up transformative businesses in Africa. Through Health54, we support
and accelerate the growth of innovative businesses with capital investment.

Le talent est partout dans les 54 pays, mais l’entrepreneuriat est freiné par le manque de capitaux
et de ressources pour développer les entreprises transformatrices en Afrique. À traversHealth54,
nous soutenons et accélérons la croissance d’entreprises innovantes avec des investissements en
capital.

### Vision & Mission
### 
### Mission et Vision

Our vision is to secure access to quality drugs. Our mission, with a pharmaceutical market that
represents more than $20 billion, bringing people quality products at affordable prices remains a
key challenge in Africa. CFAO Healthcare continues to improve healthcare on the continent by
producing and distributing pharmaceutical and medical products along with related services.

[ View more ][134]

### Carbon neutrality

Like the CFAO group as a whole, CFAO Healthcare is committed to contributing to decarbonization
efforts by aligning itself with the trajectory of the Paris agreements: reducing our greenhouse gas
emissions by 50% by 2030 compared with 2019 and achieving carbon neutrality by 2050.

[ View more ][135]

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.

  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.

  as each generation has done before.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

[Know More][14]

## **Greetings from Freyr Nigeria**

Freyr is a global Regulatory leader providing services and solutions to Life Sciences companies in
their entire Regulatory value chain. With our presence in 120+ countries, we help Life Sciences
companies in their “local to global” journey. At Freyr Nigeria, we support companies to register
their products with the NAFDAC, Regulatory strategy, market intelligence, in-country representation,
PMS functions, and more. We also offer next-gen Regulatory software solutions covering the complete
NAFDAC registration life cycle.

## Industries We Serve
* [Medicinal Products ][15]
* [Medical Devices][16]
* [Food and Food Supplements][17]
* [Cosmetics][18]

National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) is the key drug Regulatory
Authority for regulating drugs in Nigeria. The Agency was established by Decree No. 15 of 1993 as
amended by Decree No. 19 of 1999. Now, the National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and
Control Act Cap N1 Laws of the Federation of Nigeria (LFN) 2004 is responsible for regulating and
controlling the manufacture, importation, exportation, distribution, advertisement, sale and use of
Drugs.

### Freyr Expertise
* End-to-end Pharmaceutical Product Registration
* Authorized Local Agent Support
* Manufacturing Site Approval Support & Trademark registration
* Pharmaceutical Dossier Preparation and Submission to the NAFDAC
* Query Support Management till Approval
* Product maintenance & compliance

[Know More][19]
[Pharmaceutical Product Registration in Nigeria]

National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) is the key drug Regulatory
Authority for regulating drugs and medical devices in Nigeria. The Agency was established by Decree
No. 15 of 1993, as amended by Decree No. 19 of 1999. All Medical Devices should be registered in
accordance with the provisions of NAFDAC act CAP N1 (LFN) 2004, other related legislations and the
accompanying guidelines.

### Freyr Expertise
* End-to-end Medical Device Registration
* Local Authorized Representation
* Regulatory Consultation & Support on Medical Device Regulations
* Sample Import Permit and Testing Co-ordination Services
* Trademark Registration
* Advertising Permit Management

[Know More][20]
[Medical Device Registration in Nigeria]

National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) is responsible for regulating
and controlling the manufacture, importation, exportation, advertisement, distribution of the food
products in Nigeria. It is necessary to emphasize that, no food products shall be manufactured,
imported, exported, advertised, sold or distributed in Nigeria unless it has been registered in
accordance with the provisions of Act CAP N1 (LFN) 2004, other related legislations and the
accompanying Guidelines.

### Freyr Expertise
* Regulatory Strategy for Nigeria
* Product Classification
* Formula Review/Ingredients Assessment
* Label and Claims Review
* Compilation and Submission of Dossier to Health Authority
* Legal Representation

[Know More][21]
[NAFDAC food product registration]

In Nigeria, cosmetic products are regulated under the National Agency for Food and Drug
Administration and Control (NAFDAC) Act CAP N1 (LFN) 2004. The beauty and personal care sector in
Nigeria are blooming and the increasing competition is said to drive the demand for innovative
products in the region. In addition, intensive marketing activities are also boosting the growth of
the sector. Thus, making Nigeria one of the most promising emerging markets for cosmetics companies
to invest, while exploring the local manufacturing opportunities as well.

### Freyr Expertise
* Regulatory Support Services & Cosmetics Registration in Nigeria
* Trademark Registration
* Local Representation
* Notarizing of Necessary Documents
* Post-approval Support like Re-registration, Cosmetics Notification for Registration for Listing,
  Endorsement

[Know More][22]
[Cosmetics Product Registration in Nigeria]

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

We believe consistency and transparency form the foundation of trust. Our proven, methodical
approach ensures you receive the right products, at the right time, with complete peace of mind.
01

### Consult & Assess

We begin by thoroughly understanding your facility's specific needs, usage patterns, and challenges.
This collaborative assessment allows us to tailor a supply plan that optimizes your inventory and
budget.
02

### Source & Validate

Our procurement team leverages trusted global and local networks to source required products. Each
item is rigorously validated against strict quality and regulatory standards before entering our
secured supply chain.
03

### Manage & Assure

Your order is processed through our integrated inventory and logistics system. We manage all
details, storage, documentation, and scheduling, while our quality assurance protocols guarantee
product integrity.
04

### Deliver & Support

We ensure timely, traceable delivery to your location. Our partnership continues with follow-up
support, ensuring satisfaction and preparing for your next supply cycle, completing a seamless
circle of reliability.

Our Process

## A Reliable, Step-by-Step Supply Chain Partnership

We believe consistency and transparency form the foundation of trust. Our proven, methodical
approach ensures you receive the right products, at the right time, with complete peace of mind.
01

### Consult & Assess

We begin by thoroughly understanding your facility's specific needs, usage patterns, and challenges.
This collaborative assessment allows us to tailor a supply plan that optimizes your inventory and
budget.
02

### Source & Validate

Our procurement team leverages trusted global and local networks to source required products. Each
item is rigorously validated against strict quality and regulatory standards before entering our
secured supply chain.
03

### Manage & Assure

Your order is processed through our integrated inventory and logistics system. We manage all
details, storage, documentation, and scheduling, while our quality assurance protocols guarantee
product integrity.
04

### Deliver & Support

We ensure timely, traceable delivery to your location. Our partnership continues with follow-up
support, ensuring satisfaction and preparing for your next supply cycle, completing a seamless
circle of reliability.

### Why Tetanus Antitoxin is Essential for Livestock in Africa

][154]
[

## Introduction: A Silent Threat to Africa’s Livestock Economy

Africa is home to one-third of the world’s livestock-. The continent’s livestock sector supports an
estimated **350 million people** and contributes **12% to Africa’s GDP** and **42% to its
agricultural GDP.** In countries like Kenya, livestock accounts for 42% of agricultural GDP-; in
some nations, it contributes up to 80% of national GDP-. The Africa Livestock Market was valued at
approximately $75 billion in 2022 and is projected to reach $125 billion in the coming years.

][155]

[Yet behind these impressive numbers lies a persistent and preventable threat: **tetanus**. While
tetanus has become a rarity in developed countries due to routine vaccination][156][-13][157], it
remains a daily danger for millions of livestock and working animals across Africa. For veterinary
biologics suppliers like your company — already equipped with UAE registration and a
price-competitive Tetanus Antitoxin (TAT) product — this represents not just a humanitarian
opportunity, but a significant market opening.

learn more

### Plant-derived Squalene Market Analysis

][158]
[

# WHITE PAPER: The Global Squalene Market

## Sustainable Sourcing, Regulatory Landscapes, and Strategic Opportunities (2025-2034)

**Publication Date:** April 2026
**Target Audience:** Cosmetic Brand Owners, Pharmaceutical Procurement, Raw Material Distributors

### Executive Summary

][159]

[The global squalene market is undergoing a fundamental transformation. Driven by regulatory
pressure in Europe, ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) commitments from major brands, and
biotechnological innovation, the industry is rapidly shifting away from traditional animal sources
toward **plant-based and biosynthetic
alternatives**.][160][https://www.jxserum.com/other-extracts/][161]

This white paper provides a data-driven analysis of the market dynamics, regulatory frameworks
(specifically the EU ban on shark-derived squalene in cosmetics), supply chain challenges, and the
forecasted growth trajectory through 2034.

**Key Findings:**
1. **Market Growth:** The market is projected to grow from **USD 185.03 million (2025) to USD 437.36
   million by 2034**, at a CAGR of 10.10% .
2. **Regional Dominance:** **Europe holds 48% of the global market share**, driven by stringent
   sustainability laws .
3. **Segmentation:** Cosmetics represent 70.51% of end-use, but Pharmaceuticals (vaccine adjuvants)
   are the fastest-growing segment.
4. **Sourcing Shift:** Plant-derived squalene is the fastest-growing source type, responding to the
   ban on animal-derived versions in key regions .

learn more
[Plant-derived Squalene Market Analysis]

Apr 17 , 2026

### Why Dexamethasone Sodium Phosphate API Remains a Critical Molecule in Modern Medicine

][162]
[In the world of corticosteroids, few molecules have demonstrated the versatility, potency, and
clinical staying power of **Dexamethasone Sodium Phosphate**.
][163][https://www.jxserum.com/apis-intermediates/][164]While the base molecule dexamethasone has
been known for decades, its phosphate salt form—specifically the API (Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient)—is the workhorse behind some of the most essential injectable and ophthalmic drugs on
the market today.
For procurement managers, formulators, and R&D teams, understanding the technical nuances of this
API is not just a matter of chemistry—it is a matter of therapeutic efficacy and patient safety.

## Introduction: A Silent Threat to Africa’s Livestock Economy

Africa is home to one-third of the world’s livestock-. The continent’s livestock sector supports an
estimated **350 million people** and contributes **12% to Africa’s GDP** and **42% to its
agricultural GDP.** In countries like Kenya, livestock accounts for 42% of agricultural GDP-; in
some nations, it contributes up to 80% of national GDP-. The Africa Livestock Market was valued at
approximately $75 billion in 2022 and is projected to reach $125 billion in the coming years.

   sustainability laws .
3. **Segmentation:** Cosmetics represent 70.51% of end-use, but Pharmaceuticals (vaccine adjuvants)
   are the fastest-growing segment.

   ban on animal-derived versions in key regions .

# From the *pharmacy of the world* to your tender desk.

M Care is an Indian-owned pharmaceutical export house supplying **WHO-GMP and EU-GMP** medicines,
biologicals and surgical consumables to hospitals, importers and government tender desks across
**the United Kingdom, the GCC, and Africa**, with destination-ready dossiers, validated cold-chain,
and a single named account manager on every shipment.

## Our supply-integrity promise.

For a buyer who has never met us, the real question is not the price. It is whether the box is what
the label says. This is the chain we hold on every single line we ship.

### Manufacturer-direct

Every line is sourced straight from a WHO-GMP manufacturer against your purchase order. We are not a
broker, we hold no speculative stock, and we do not buy on the grey market.

### Documented end to end

A batch Certificate of Analysis, the WHO-format CoPP, the manufacturer's GMP certificate and the
cold-chain trail travel with the consignment, prepared to your destination regulator's expectation.

### To your licensed entity

We supply the WHO-GMP product; the importer of record is your own licensed local entity. One named
desk carries the order from purchase order to the signature on the delivery note.

①

### Rooted in the world's pharmacy

India supplies ~60% of the world's vaccines and the largest share of quality-assured generics
outside the US. That is the manufacturing base we buy against, then QA, dossier and ship on your
behalf.

②

### Regulator-ready, destination-first

CTD/eCTD dossiers written for MHRA, EMA, SFDA, MoH-UAE, NAFDAC and the rest of the regulators we
ship into, not a generic template repurposed page-by-page.

③

### One named person on every order

No call-centre triage, no vanishing reply chains. Your Mumbai desk knows your molecule, your market,
your pack-size preference and your customs broker by name.

From the field

## Three recent shipment patterns.

**UK Specials, docetaxel shortage window.** Reg. 167 named-patient consignment closed the
licensed-source gap in 11 days end-to-end. Document pack pre-built; cold-chain on the BOM-LHR lane.

**UK MHRA-licensed Specials importer** 2024 · 240 vials · anonymised at customer request

**Gulf hospital, biological cold-chain.** Active-shipper consignment, 72-hour BOM-DXB lane.
Continuous IoT logging in transit. Logger record: zero excursions outside the 2-8°C band.

**Gulf university hospital network** 2025 · 4-shipper pallet · 0 excursions · anonymised

**NUPCO central tender response.** 18-day biosimilar tender window. CTD dossier harmonised to GHC
central format; SFDA stability appendix; Arabic-language SmPC. Response went on day 14.

**NUPCO biosimilar tender (Saudi Arabia)** 2025 · GHC central dossier · day 14 of 18

**Also documented across the African lane:** KEMSA Kenya anti-infective framework supply (2024),
Tanzania MSD ARV catalogue dispatch under the WHO PQ collaborative procedure (2025, 11-week
time-to-first-dispatch versus an 18-month standard registration cycle), NAFDAC Nigeria
verification-track filings for haematology biosimilars (2024), FDA Ghana ICUMS-portal lodgement for
a Christian Health Association of Ghana (CHAG) wholesaler partner (2025).

Buyer references available against signed mutual NDA. Direct introduction facilitated where a
prospective buyer's diligence requires a peer reference.

Latest from the desk

## Practical notes from the regulatory and tender lanes we run.

[ Saudi Arabia · SFDA & NUPCO

### Sourcing Indian generics into Saudi Arabia

SFDA marketing authorisation held through your local agent, NUPCO supplier registration as a
separate step, and why a pure import competes uphill under Vision 2030 local content.

Read note → ][67] [ Trade · Incoterms 2020

### Incoterms and payment terms for pharma imports

Where risk and cost transfer (and why DDP rarely fits regulated medicine), plus the payment
instrument that protects both sides: advance, Letter of Credit, D/P, D/A.

Read note → ][68] [ UAE · EDE

### EDE registration for UAE imports, after MOHAP

Drug registration moved to the Emirates Drug Establishment on 29 December 2025. The local-agent
rule, the new two-importer requirement, and what is still transitional.

Read note → ][69]

[All insights →][70]

**Tradition**
Being offended by facts is a long human tradition.
*Megan O'Keefe - Velocity Weapon *

**Mysterious**
The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and
science. He to whom the emotion is a stranger, who can no longer pause to wonder and stand wrapped
in awe, is as good as dead —his eyes are closed.
*Albert Einstein *

**Inspirational Quote of the Week**
Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
* Mahatma Gandhi*

**No fear**
"Don't let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game."
*Babe Ruth*

**Basic Rule**
Energy can neither be created nor destroyed, but only transformed from one form to another.
*The law of conservation of energy*

 


**Are you confused by all the conflicting messages that rush at us daily? You are not alone. **

But be aware that this also happens to less educated people (like me) who are even less able to
understand what interests are behind these messages.
Many people feel more and more helpless or ignore the obvious and run to the next strong man.
How can this be avoided in the future?

Education could help. Give the next generation a better chance. Teach them [critical thinking][156],
make them understand the connections.

*From innovative brands to nationwide delivery
a 21‑year story of reliability, scale, and care driven by

## Excellent Client Service Delivery

We provide excellent customer care, advisory services and
support tailored to the needs of Healthcare providers.
We have created a customer-centric system with our staff
equipped with the requisite tools to deliver efficiency and
best-in-class services.

## NHP Online
## Ordering Pad

## For New Heights Pharma Wholesales Ltd

With our Online Ordering Pad, registered pharmacies and
hospitals are able to place their orders and monitor their
transactions online real-time.

[ GET STARTED ][30]

## A one stop Healthcare Product
## Wholesale Centre

New Heights Pharma delivers quality healthcare products from its over 3000sqm wholesale and
distribution centre located in the centre of Lagos to over 4000 Healthcare providers in Nigeria and
across Africa.

## Nationwide Distribution Network

New Heights Pharma has one of the most extensive distribution network in Nigeria. Headquartered from
Lagos, We are able to supply quality healthcare products and services to over 4000 healthcare
providers and institutions in Nigeria, using our own logistics team trained on the importance of
Good Distribution Practice as well as other accredited logistics companies.

## not an healthcare professional

#### We've Got you Covered

[ Click here ][31]

#### Our Services

##### Wholesale

We as wholesalers act as middlemen for retail Pharmacies, Hospitals and other Health institutions.

[ Learn More ][32]

##### Distribution

We represent and distribute/Market products for International and Local brand that we are in
partnership with using dedicated field force personnel

[ Learn More ][33]

##### Marketing

We provide information by advertising and promoting our brands and product to the public.as well as
market and detail our products and services to healthcare professionals.

##### Consulting

We leverage our in-depth and cutting edge knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape to
provide a range of pharmaceutical consulting.

###### Our Culture

#### Excellent Service Delivery

We provide excellent services and support tailored to the needs of our customers. We have created a
customer focused environment where our staff are equipped with the tools to deliver quality products
and best-in-class services.

Receiving front door delivery service for your order is only a matter of getting in touch with our
customer care team.

We provide nationwide delivery services for orders received by Email, Text messages & Telephone
calls:
* 24 hours door step delivery within Lagos
* 72 hours nationwide door step delivery

At New Heights Pharma we strive to provide an efficient and fast turnaround on all orders placed.
Our customer relations officers are available between:
* 8am – 5pm Mondays to Fridays
* 9am – 3pm on Saturdays and Public holidays

###### Our Product

#### Leveraging Technology in Distribution and Sales

We have over the years developed requisite technological capabilities to automate our processes and
make transactions with our customers easy and seamless. With our Online Ordering Pad, registered
retail pharmacies and hospitals/clinics are able to make transactions and monitor their transactions
online real-time. With our app, customers are able to achieve the following:
* Automatically generate purchase orders for delivery
* Monitor orders online from the point of order to delivery
* Order to Cash Management and Automation
* Store transaction history with our company
* Get online notification on every order process
* Use one account to place orders for multiple locations and more

## New Heights Pharma Group

*From innovative brands to nationwide delivery
a 21‑year story of reliability, scale, and care driven by
Technology, Integrity, Professionalism and Service (TIPS)*

## Excellent Client Service Delivery

We provide excellent customer care, advisory services and
support tailored to the needs of Healthcare providers.
We have created a customer-centric system with our staff
equipped with the requisite tools to deliver efficiency and
best-in-class services.

## NHP Online
## Ordering Pad

## For New Heights Pharma Wholesales Ltd

With our Online Ordering Pad, registered pharmacies and
hospitals are able to place their orders and monitor their
transactions online real-time.

[ GET STARTED ][30]

## A one stop Healthcare Product
## Wholesale Centre

New Heights Pharma delivers quality healthcare products from its over 3000sqm wholesale and
distribution centre located in the centre of Lagos to over 4000 Healthcare providers in Nigeria and
across Africa.

## Nationwide Distribution Network

New Heights Pharma has one of the most extensive distribution network in Nigeria. Headquartered from
Lagos, We are able to supply quality healthcare products and services to over 4000 healthcare
providers and institutions in Nigeria, using our own logistics team trained on the importance of
Good Distribution Practice as well as other accredited logistics companies.

## not an healthcare professional

#### We've Got you Covered

[ Click here ][31]

#### Our Services

##### Wholesale

We as wholesalers act as middlemen for retail Pharmacies, Hospitals and other Health institutions.

[ Learn More ][32]

##### Distribution

We represent and distribute/Market products for International and Local brand that we are in
partnership with using dedicated field force personnel

[ Learn More ][33]

##### Marketing

We provide information by advertising and promoting our brands and product to the public.as well as
market and detail our products and services to healthcare professionals.

##### Consulting

We leverage our in-depth and cutting edge knowledge of the regulatory and compliance landscape to
provide a range of pharmaceutical consulting.

###### Our Culture

#### Excellent Service Delivery

We provide excellent services and support tailored to the needs of our customers. We have created a
customer focused environment where our staff are equipped with the tools to deliver quality products
and best-in-class services.

Receiving front door delivery service for your order is only a matter of getting in touch with our
customer care team.

We provide nationwide delivery services for orders received by Email, Text messages & Telephone
calls:
* 24 hours door step delivery within Lagos
* 72 hours nationwide door step delivery

At New Heights Pharma we strive to provide an efficient and fast turnaround on all orders placed.
Our customer relations officers are available between:
* 8am – 5pm Mondays to Fridays
* 9am – 3pm on Saturdays and Public holidays

###### Our Product

#### Leveraging Technology in Distribution and Sales

We have over the years developed requisite technological capabilities to automate our processes and
make transactions with our customers easy and seamless. With our Online Ordering Pad, registered
retail pharmacies and hospitals/clinics are able to make transactions and monitor their transactions
online real-time. With our app, customers are able to achieve the following:
* Automatically generate purchase orders for delivery
* Monitor orders online from the point of order to delivery
* Order to Cash Management and Automation
* Store transaction history with our company
* Get online notification on every order process
* Use one account to place orders for multiple locations and more

# Globally Recognized Pharmaceutical Formulation Importer & Supplier

Esmero Pharmaceutical Ltd. is a Pharmaceutical services company registered with the corporate
affairs commission of the federal republic of Nigeria. The company has since then been active in
drug distribution and supplies in Nigeria. it maintains an active relationship with professionals
within and outside Nigeria. The company is presently active in the importation of pharmaceutical
products that are duly registered with NAFDAC.

## Quality of Our Products
* [Who We Are][17]
* [Quality][18]

We are a leading pharmaceutical company in Lagos largest city of Nigeria that specialises in the
importation, sales, marketing and distribution of pharmaceutical products in the Nigerian market.

The quality of our products is something that we never leave to chance. The products are checked at
every level to ensure complete flawlessness and customer satisfaction. The quality inspections are
conducted in the laboratories according to rules evolved by us. Our dedication to quality in
everything we do is uncompromising, and covers every stage of the development, importation product
and marketing of our medicines from the supply of materials through manufacturing and approval by
the strictest authorities in Nigeria.

## New Levels Of Excellence In Pharmaceutical Formulations For A Better Life

At EPL, we aspire to aid the community in leading a healthy life by formulating; Importing,
marketing, and delivering affordable and accessible medicines that satisfy urgent medical needs.

regulating and granting permits for the exportation, importation, manufacture.

set up in the North Indian State of Uttarakhand. It is USFDA approved.

NIROPHARM is the Umbrella Body of Nigerian Representatives of Overseas Pharmaceutical Manufacturers,
with a distinctive Research and Development Orientation that encompasses a wide variety of
pharmaceutical marketing companies, but all with a common trait of representing one or many overseas
pharmaceutical manufacturers.
NIROPHARM is at the forefront of advocating and actively supporting tangibly improvement of the
Pharma Sector in Drug Availability, Affordability, Distribution and Quality across the entire Pharma
Value Chain. The pharmaceutical market in Nigeria is estimated to reach US\$1,839 million in 2025
(Source: Statista Market Forecast, Nigerian Pharmacies, 2025)
NIROPHARM is responsible for a large percentage of Pharmaceuticals imported into, and in circulation
in Nigeria and active in the News Media over issues relevant to the industry. Imports of
Pharmaceutical products constitute 70% of the Nigerian Pharma industry, while local Manufacture
accounts for the remaining 30%.

## Pharma Wholesalers & Distributors Association of Nigeria
## Annual Conference

The PWDAN Annual Conference takes place on day 3 of Pharma West Africa and connects exhibitors
directly with Nigeria’s leading pharmaceutical importers and distributors.
Benefits of the partnership:
* Exclusive opportunity for exhibitors to engage directly with **PWDAN’s distributor network**.
* Meet **300+ directors** and **decision-makers** from **pharmaceutical wholesalers and
  distributors**.
* Discuss and secure distribution opportunities across Nigeria and wider West Africa.

To engage with PWDAN’s trusted distributor network, secure your position on the exhibition floor.

[Book a stand][166]

Through this exclusive partnership, WAAS personally invites and hosts key ASPMDA members, connecting
them directly with global exhibitors to source products and secure new partnerships.

As part of the partnership, we personally provide shuttle bus transportation to and from the
exhibition to ensure their attendance to meet the exhibitors.

The partnership is reinforced by the continued involvement of ASPMDA President Hon. Ngozi Emechebe,
who contributes to the WAAS conference programme each year and actively promotes the event to all
participating members.

[Book a stand ][167]

## STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS

Pharma West Africa works closely with key industry bodies and regulators, giving exhibitors trusted
**access to verified buyers**, **stronger market credibility**, and a **reliable platform for
compliant trade** and **long-term growth** across West Africa’s pharmaceutical market.

Meet the organisations driving Africa’s pharmaceutical industry to build partnerships and grow your
business.

[Book a stand ][168]
×

#### Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria

The Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria is the umbrella Association advocating for the improvement and
welfare of all groups in the Nigerian Pharmaceutical Sector. They offer expert advice on drug
interactions, side effects, dosage, and best practices in medication management, empowering informed
decisions in clinical care and everyday health.

×

#### Pharmaceutical Importers and Wholesalers Association of Ghana (PIWA)

The Pharmaceutical Importers and Wholesalers Association of Ghana (PIWA) is an organized body for
businesses that import and wholesale pharmaceuticals in Ghana. It was formed to allow these
companies to make collective input into the pharmaceutical industry and the national economy.

×

#### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers and Distributors Association of Nigeria PWDAN

The Pharmaceutical Wholesalers and Distributors Association of Nigeria PWDAN is a trade association
of companies involved in professional Wholesaling and Distribution with the aim to foster Best
Practices in the Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and contribute to the advancement of Supply Chain
integrity in pharmaceutical practice.

×

#### National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC)

The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) was established to
regulate and control the manufacture, importation, exportation, distribution, advertisement, sale
and use of Food, Drugs, Cosmetics, Medical Devices, Packaged Water, Chemicals and Detergents.

×

#### Healthcare Federation of Nigeria (HFN)

HFN is an umbrella body for private-sector stakeholders that plays a pivotal role in shaping policy,
fostering partnerships, and driving innovations that enhance access to quality healthcare services
for all Nigerians.

×

#### Pharmacists Council of Nigeria (PCN)

PCN is a Federal Government parastatal charged with the responsibility of regulating and controlling
pharmacy education, training and practice in all aspects and ramifications, including regulating
Pharmacy Technicians and Patent and Proprietary Medicines Vendors (PPMVs).

×

#### Ghana National Chamber of Pharmacy (GNCOP)

The Ghana National Chamber of Pharmacy (GNCoP) is an organization that advocates for the
pharmaceutical industry in Ghana by connecting stakeholders, informing members, and fighting for the
sector's growth.

×

#### Ghana National Business Council (GNBC)

The GNBC’s key objective is to promote trade between Ghana and Nigeria and encourage a smooth
transition and provide the necessary support for interested parties to set up trade in Ghana.

brings together key stakeholders in the pharma and healthcare sector across West Africa.

with he organisation, hospitality and very impressed with he tremendous number and quality of
visitors.

#### Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria

The Pharmaceutical Society of Nigeria is the umbrella Association advocating for the improvement and
welfare of all groups in the Nigerian Pharmaceutical Sector. They offer expert advice on drug
interactions, side effects, dosage, and best practices in medication management, empowering informed
decisions in clinical care and everyday health.

#### Pharmaceutical Importers and Wholesalers Association of Ghana (PIWA)

The Pharmaceutical Importers and Wholesalers Association of Ghana (PIWA) is an organized body for
businesses that import and wholesale pharmaceuticals in Ghana. It was formed to allow these
companies to make collective input into the pharmaceutical industry and the national economy.

×

#### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers and Distributors Association of Nigeria PWDAN

The Pharmaceutical Wholesalers and Distributors Association of Nigeria PWDAN is a trade association
of companies involved in professional Wholesaling and Distribution with the aim to foster Best
Practices in the Pharmaceutical Supply Chain and contribute to the advancement of Supply Chain
integrity in pharmaceutical practice.

×

#### National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC)

The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) was established to
regulate and control the manufacture, importation, exportation, distribution, advertisement, sale
and use of Food, Drugs, Cosmetics, Medical Devices, Packaged Water, Chemicals and Detergents.

×

#### Healthcare Federation of Nigeria (HFN)

HFN is an umbrella body for private-sector stakeholders that plays a pivotal role in shaping policy,
fostering partnerships, and driving innovations that enhance access to quality healthcare services
for all Nigerians.

×

PCN is a Federal Government parastatal charged with the responsibility of regulating and controlling
pharmacy education, training and practice in all aspects and ramifications, including regulating
Pharmacy Technicians and Patent and Proprietary Medicines Vendors (PPMVs).

×

pharmaceutical industry in Ghana by connecting stakeholders, informing members, and fighting for the
sector's growth.

×

The GNBC’s key objective is to promote trade between Ghana and Nigeria and encourage a smooth
transition and provide the necessary support for interested parties to set up trade in Ghana.

# Mastering Global Regulatory Affairs in the Pharmaceutical Industry

## 1. Understanding the Role of Pharma Regulatory Affairs

Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs is a multidisciplinary function within the pharmaceutical and
biotechnology industries. It plays a critical role in ensuring that all products—drugs, biologics,
and medical devices—comply with the regulations and standards required by regulatory agencies across
various countries. The regulatory affairs department acts as the interface between pharmaceutical
companies and regulatory bodies such as the FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), CDSCO
(India), PMDA (Japan), and TGA (Australia). These agencies are responsible for reviewing and
approving drug applications, overseeing safety reporting, and enforcing post-approval compliance.

At its core, regulatory affairs involves the preparation, compilation, and submission of a wide
range of regulatory documents. These documents include dossiers (CTD/eCTD), product labels, periodic
safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for

# Mastering Global Regulatory Affairs in the Pharmaceutical Industry

## 1. Understanding the Role of Pharma Regulatory Affairs

Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs is a multidisciplinary function within the pharmaceutical and

and medical devices—comply with the regulations and standards required by regulatory agencies across
various countries. The regulatory affairs department acts as the interface between pharmaceutical
companies and regulatory bodies such as the FDA (United States), EMA (European Union), CDSCO
(India), PMDA (Japan), and TGA (Australia). These agencies are responsible for reviewing and
approving drug applications, overseeing safety reporting, and enforcing post-approval compliance.

At its core, regulatory affairs involves the preparation, compilation, and submission of a wide
range of regulatory documents. These documents include dossiers (CTD/eCTD), product labels, periodic
safety reports, clinical trial applications, and responses to regulatory queries. In addition, the
regulatory team ensures that the company’s products are registered correctly in each market,
labeling is compliant, and pharmacovigilance systems are in place. Regulatory professionals must
stay up to date with evolving legislation and guidance documents, as non-compliance can result in
delayed product approvals, fines, or even market bans.

The scope of regulatory affairs is not limited to product approval. It extends to lifecycle
management, including post-marketing surveillance, renewals, and variations. Companies often rely on
regulatory intelligence to anticipate changes in global legislation and proactively adjust their
strategies. As global markets expand, pharmaceutical companies increasingly need to harmonize their
regulatory strategies across jurisdictions while addressing country-specific requirements. This need
gives rise to regulatory harmonization initiatives like ICH (International Council for
Harmonisation) and WHO’s collaborative registration procedures.

Ultimately, regulatory affairs ensure that patients have timely access to safe and effective
medications. It helps companies navigate a highly regulated environment, reduce compliance risks,
and bring innovations to market faster. As the regulatory landscape becomes more complex with the
advent of gene therapy, biosimilars, and personalized medicine, the demand for skilled regulatory
professionals continues to rise. For these reasons, pharma regulatory affairs are not just a support
function—they are a strategic pillar of the pharmaceutical business model.

## 2. Key Global Regulatory Authorities and Their Requirements

Pharmaceutical companies operating globally must adhere to regulatory frameworks set by each
country’s competent authority. These agencies oversee the entire lifecycle of pharmaceutical
products—from clinical trials to marketing authorization and post-market surveillance. The major
regulatory bodies include the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), European Medicines Agency
(EMA), Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) in India, the Pharmaceuticals and Medical
Devices Agency (PMDA) in Japan, and the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) in Australia. Each
agency has its own application formats, timelines, electronic submission systems, and regulatory
expectations, making it crucial for regulatory teams to adopt a tailored approach for each region.

The U.S. FDA regulates drugs, biologics, and medical devices through a robust system that includes
pre-IND (Investigational New Drug) meetings, submission of IND applications for clinical trials, and
final approval via NDA (New Drug Application) or BLA (Biologics License Application). The FDA
mandates submission in electronic format via the Electronic Submissions Gateway (ESG) using the eCTD
standard. Additionally, periodic safety reporting, annual updates, and compliance with labeling and
promotional guidelines are essential post-approval obligations.

The EMA functions under the centralized procedure, where a single application leads to marketing
authorization across all EU member states. It also supports decentralized and mutual recognition
procedures (DCP and MRP) for drugs not eligible for centralized review. EMA requires rigorous
compliance with ICH guidelines and regional documentation in Module 1 of the eCTD. Scientific
advice, orphan designation, and accelerated assessment pathways are additional features companies
can leverage to expedite approvals.

In India, CDSCO governs drug approvals under the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019. All
applications—whether for clinical trial permission or marketing authorization—must be submitted
through the SUGAM portal. CDSCO places a strong emphasis on local clinical trial data, especially

## PWDAN inauguration

### ** PWDAN**

#### ** The role we play**

The global development paradigm within the supply chain has made a tremendous impact that has
changed the face of pharmaceutical distribution with the attendant disruptions. In order to be
relevant in this era of uncertainty and disruptions, pharmaceutical wholesalers  and distributors
need to define its relevance in the rapidly changing supply chain landscape. The most perceived
strategy to overcome these challenges is by companies with common objective and interest to become
more resilient, collaborative and networked with other stake holders and players in the chain.
 Collectively they will be able to launch their entities/companies as vector of progress and
change.  This necessitated the coming together of this group.

### To protect

## To protect, project and harmonize the overall interest of PWDAN.

### To promote

## To promote good professional and inter-personal relationship among PWDAN members.

### To organize

## Organize workshops and seminars that promote global best practices in the pharmaceutical Supply
## chain

## PWDAN inauguration

### ** PWDAN**

#### ** The role we play**

The global development paradigm within the supply chain has made a tremendous impact that has
changed the face of pharmaceutical distribution with the attendant disruptions. In order to be
relevant in this era of uncertainty and disruptions, pharmaceutical wholesalers  and distributors
need to define its relevance in the rapidly changing supply chain landscape. The most perceived
strategy to overcome these challenges is by companies with common objective and interest to become
more resilient, collaborative and networked with other stake holders and players in the chain.
 Collectively they will be able to launch their entities/companies as vector of progress and
change.  This necessitated the coming together of this group.

### To protect

## To protect, project and harmonize the overall interest of PWDAN.

### To promote

## To promote good professional and inter-personal relationship among PWDAN members.

### To organize

## Our Core Values

The principles that guide every interaction, every prescription, and every service we provide.

01

##### Patient-Centered Care

We focus on each patient's specific needs, preferences, and health conditions — offering tailored
advice and counseling to ensure treatment plans align with health goals.

02

##### Professionalism

We demonstrate integrity, honesty, and responsibility in every aspect of pharmacy practice — held to
the highest ethical and professional standards.

03

##### Commitment to Safety

We play a crucial role in preventing medication errors, identifying drug interactions, and advising
on safe usage — your safety is our first priority.

04

##### Collaboration & Teamwork

We work closely with doctors, nurses, and healthcare providers to ensure patients receive
comprehensive and coordinated care across all disciplines.

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

# POPULAR CATEGORIES

## CONSUMABLES

Every patient interaction, from the first assessment to the final step in care, relies on the
precision and safety of medical consumables. Uni-medical’s consumables are trusted by healthcare
professionals to support safe procedures, protect patients and practitioners, and keep clinical
environments running smoothly.

[DISCOVER][40]

## IN VITRO DIAGNOSTIC

Behind every informed medical decision is a reliable test result. Uni-medical’s IVD solutions equip
laboratories with innovative diagnostic technologies and reagents that support accurate detection,
monitoring, and management of disease.

[DISCOVER][41]

## RADIOLOGY

From first scan to final diagnosis, imaging plays a critical role in patient care. Uni-medical’s
radiology solutions provide reliable technologies that help clinicians capture detailed images,
detect conditions early, and guide the right treatment decisions.

[DISCOVER][42]

## WOUND CARE & SUTURES

Millions of people around the world suffer from chronic wounds, often facing months of pain, reduced
quality of life, and ongoing care needs. With our advanced wound care products and sutures, we are
committed to helping patients achieve the effective, precise solutions they need for optimal healing
and better outcomes.

[DISCOVER][43]

## CRITICAL CARE

When every heartbeat matters, every monitor counts. Uni-medical’s critical care systems give
clinicians the tools to act fast, stay precise, and save lives, because in the ICU, seconds make the
difference.

[DISCOVER][44]

## ENDOSCOPY

Modern care demands precision. Uni-medical’s endoscopy technologies help clinicians visualize,
diagnose, and treat conditions with the precision required for minimally invasive medicine.

[DISCOVER][45]

##### What products does Uni-medical supply?

systems, critical care devices, endoscopy technologies, medical consumables, and laboratory
solutions.

##### What category of medical comsumables do you supply?

Uni-medical supplies essential consumables such as gloves, PPE, wound care products, infection
control products and other clinical supplies used daily in healthcare settings.

### Can’t find an answer to your question?

We have more answers to your frequently asked questions

[GET AN ANSWER][51]

##### Do you provide delivery for medical equipment supplies?

Yes. We manage the logistics and delivery of medical equipment and supplies to healthcare
facilities. Our team works to ensure products are delivered safely and efficiently to support timely
installation and use.

##### Can we request a product demonstration?

Yes. Healthcare facilities can request a product demonstration to better understand how specific
equipment works and how it can support their clinical needs. Simply submit a request through our
contact or sales inquiry form, and our team will coordinate the next steps.

##### Do you provide installation for medical equipment?

Yes. Our engineering team provides professional installation to ensure all equipment is set up
correctly and performs to the highest standards.

## CONSUMABLES

Every patient interaction, from the first assessment to the final step in care, relies on the
precision and safety of medical consumables. Uni-medical’s consumables are trusted by healthcare
professionals to support safe procedures, protect patients and practitioners, and keep clinical
environments running smoothly.

[DISCOVER][40]

## IN VITRO DIAGNOSTIC

Behind every informed medical decision is a reliable test result. Uni-medical’s IVD solutions equip
laboratories with innovative diagnostic technologies and reagents that support accurate detection,
monitoring, and management of disease.

[DISCOVER][41]

## RADIOLOGY

From first scan to final diagnosis, imaging plays a critical role in patient care. Uni-medical’s
radiology solutions provide reliable technologies that help clinicians capture detailed images,
detect conditions early, and guide the right treatment decisions.

[DISCOVER][42]

## WOUND CARE & SUTURES

Millions of people around the world suffer from chronic wounds, often facing months of pain, reduced
quality of life, and ongoing care needs. With our advanced wound care products and sutures, we are
committed to helping patients achieve the effective, precise solutions they need for optimal healing
and better outcomes.

[DISCOVER][43]

## CRITICAL CARE

When every heartbeat matters, every monitor counts. Uni-medical’s critical care systems give
clinicians the tools to act fast, stay precise, and save lives, because in the ICU, seconds make the
difference.

[DISCOVER][44]

## ENDOSCOPY

Modern care demands precision. Uni-medical’s endoscopy technologies help clinicians visualize,
diagnose, and treat conditions with the precision required for minimally invasive medicine.

[DISCOVER][45]

## FAQ’s

If you have any questions about our brands, products or company we have a team on hand to support
you throughout the working week.

Get in touch with us for anything you might need.

##### What products does Uni-medical supply?

Uni-medical provides a wide range of healthcare solutions including diagnostic equipment, radiology
systems, critical care devices, endoscopy technologies, medical consumables, and laboratory
solutions.

##### What category of medical comsumables do you supply?

Uni-medical supplies essential consumables such as gloves, PPE, wound care products, infection
control products and other clinical supplies used daily in healthcare settings.

### Can’t find an answer to your question?

We have more answers to your frequently asked questions

[GET AN ANSWER][51]

##### Do you provide delivery for medical equipment supplies?

Yes. We manage the logistics and delivery of medical equipment and supplies to healthcare
facilities. Our team works to ensure products are delivered safely and efficiently to support timely
installation and use.

##### Can we request a product demonstration?

Yes. Healthcare facilities can request a product demonstration to better understand how specific
equipment works and how it can support their clinical needs. Simply submit a request through our
contact or sales inquiry form, and our team will coordinate the next steps.

##### Do you provide installation for medical equipment?

Yes. Our engineering team provides professional installation to ensure all equipment is set up
correctly and performs to the highest standards.

##### Do you provide after-sales support for equipment?

Yes. We offer installation, preventive maintenance, calibration, and technical support through our
experienced engineering team to ensure equipment continues to perform reliably.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
